summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories (hosting and distributing weights) and developer-facing inference APIs (serving those models at scale). Hugging Face dominates as the central hub, crossing 3 million public models by August 2026, though adoption is highly concentrated—roughly the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads, with China recently surpassing the U.S. in monthly downloads. Around this hub, a competitive layer of inference providers (Together AI, Fireworks AI, Replicate, SiliconFlow) and local-first runtimes (Ollama) compete on speed, price, and ease of deployment for open-weight models.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and demos, plus hosted inference endpoints and Spaces for apps.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (crossed 3M in August 2026, adding ~747k in the first 7.7 months of 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free hosting and public access; Pro subscription (~$9/mo); pay-as-you-go serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints billed by compute/hour; Enterprise Hub tiers
features: Largest open model and dataset registry with git-based version control
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Spaces for hosting interactive demos and apps
Transformers, Diffusers, and Datasets libraries integration
Model cards, download/usage stats, and leaderboards
Routing to third-party inference providers (Together, Fireworks, etc.)
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who need to discover, share, version, and deploy open models and datasets.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local-first runtime for downloading and running open LLMs and multimodal models on personal machines and servers with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, Phi) with many quantized variants
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; runs on your own hardware (no usage fees)
features: Single-command model pull and run
Local OpenAI-compatible REST API
Automatic quantization and GGUF-based model management
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Modelfile system for custom model configuration
Offline, privacy-preserving inference
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want private, offline, local inference of open models without cloud costs.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform to run and deploy open-source and custom models via API, packaged as reproducible containers (Cog).
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community-published models across text, image, video, and audio
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU usage); varies by hardware tier
features: Run models via simple HTTP API with no infra management
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong catalog of image/video/audio generation models
Fine-tuning support for select models
Automatic scaling and cold-start handling
Webhooks and streaming outputs
platforms.best_for: App developers who want to call or deploy diverse open models (especially generative media) via API without managing GPUs.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-weight LLMs and multimodal models, plus GPU clusters for training.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (price varies by model size); per-hour GPU pricing for dedicated endpoints and training clusters
features: OpenAI-compatible serverless inference API
Optimized fast inference engine with low latency
Fine-tuning and LoRA training services
Dedicated endpoints and reserved GPU clusters
Broad support for latest open frontier models (incl. large Chinese labs)
Batch inference and JSON/function-calling support
platforms.best_for: Startups and enterprises building production apps on open LLMs that need scalable, low-latency inference and fine-tuning.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Speed-optimized inference platform for open-weight LLMs, vision, and audio models, targeting production-grade low latency and throughput.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom model and fine-tune hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing (by model); on-demand and dedicated GPU deployments billed hourly
features: Proprietary FireAttention engine for fast serving
OpenAI-compatible API
Function calling, structured output, and JSON mode
Fine-tuning and custom model deployment
Multimodal (vision, audio/transcription) support
Dedicated/reserved capacity for enterprise workloads
platforms.best_for: Teams needing the lowest-latency, high-throughput serving of open models in production, especially agentic and RAG applications.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: Inference-as-a-service platform offering fast, cost-efficient access to a wide range of open LLMs and generative models, with strong coverage of Chinese open-weight models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi/Moonshot, MiniMax, and image/video models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token/usage-based pricing, generally positioned as low-cost; free tier credits available
features: OpenAI-compatible API
Strong catalog of leading Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi)
Text, image, video, and audio generation endpoints
Optimized serving for cost efficiency
Fine-tuning and dedicated deployment options
Batch and high-concurrency support
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia-Pacific) seeking affordable access to top Chinese and global open-weight models via a unified API.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: Ultra-low-latency inference platform powered by custom LPU hardware, serving popular open-weight LLMs at very high token speeds.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, Gemma, DeepSeek distills)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; competitive per-million-token rates; free developer tier
features: Custom LPU hardware for industry-leading throughput and low latency
OpenAI-compatible API
Deterministic, high-speed token generation
Function calling and structured outputs
Simple developer onboarding with generous free tier
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time, latency-sensitive applications (chat, voice, agents) on open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and closed model providers, letting developers access hundreds of models through one endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated across dozens of providers (open and proprietary)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing with a small routing margin; credits-based billing
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic failover and provider/price routing
Transparent per-model pricing and usage analytics
Access to both open-weight and frontier closed models
Model ranking and availability insights
platforms.best_for: Developers who want provider-agnostic access and automatic cost/latency routing across many models.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: Serverless cloud platform for running custom AI/ML code and model inference, with on-demand GPU provisioning defined in Python.
platforms.model_count: Any model (bring-your-own); run models from Hugging Face or custom weights
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second compute (CPU/GPU) usage; generous free monthly credits
features: Define containers and GPU jobs entirely in Python
Rapid autoscaling and scale-to-zero
Serverless GPU inference and batch processing
Integration with Hugging Face model downloads
Scheduled jobs and web endpoints
platforms.best_for: Engineers who want to deploy custom open models and pipelines serverlessly without managing infrastructure.
